description: Deletes a tag table with every tag and constant in it (a user table group is searched; exact name first, then ignoring case). The DEFAULT tag table is refused with 409 default_tag_table (details.table, isDefault:true); an unknown table is 404 not_found. dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve (needs an open project): it runs the same guards and lists the tags and constants that would go, WITHOUT deleting. Maps to DELETE /plcs/{plc}/tagtables/{table}. M-off.

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project
